cards.title: Retained-frame coverage
cards.explanation: Fraction of all 1,337 corrected validation attempts retained by the frozen rule. Conditional errors are interpretable only beside attempted-frame coverage. Corrected DEVELOPMENT acquisition families; biological mouse identity unavailable. Coverage accompanies every conditional error estimate.

cards.title: Pupil diameter error
cards.explanation: Unweighted acquisition-family macro mean absolute relative diameter error. This is the frozen cross-method ranking endpoint on the same mask-derived GT scalar. Corrected DEVELOPMENT acquisition families; biological mouse identity unavailable. Coverage accompanies every conditional error estimate.

cards.title: Diameter MAE
cards.explanation: Mean absolute pupil equivalent-diameter error on retained frames. Reports error in source-image pixels alongside the normalized primary endpoint. Corrected DEVELOPMENT acquisition families; biological mouse identity unavailable. Coverage accompanies every conditional error estimate.

cards.title: Diameter RMSE
cards.explanation: Root-mean-square pupil equivalent-diameter error on retained frames. Upweights large diameter failures. Corrected DEVELOPMENT acquisition families; biological mouse identity unavailable. Coverage accompanies every conditional error estimate.

cards.title: Median diameter error
cards.explanation: Median absolute relative diameter error on retained frames. Shows the typical retained-frame error without replacing the family-macro endpoint. Corrected DEVELOPMENT acquisition families; biological mouse identity unavailable. Coverage accompanies every conditional error estimate.

cards.title: P95 diameter error
cards.explanation: 95th percentile absolute relative diameter error on retained frames. Makes the retained-frame error tail visible. Corrected DEVELOPMENT acquisition families; biological mouse identity unavailable. Coverage accompanies every conditional error estimate.

cards.title: Diameter signed bias
cards.explanation: Mean signed diameter error divided by GT diameter. Separates systematic over-estimation from under-estimation. Corrected DEVELOPMENT acquisition families; biological mouse identity unavailable. Coverage accompanies every conditional error estimate.

cards.title: Catastrophic diameter failures
cards.explanation: Fraction of retained frames with diameter ARE above 20%. Exposes severe errors hidden by an average. Corrected DEVELOPMENT acquisition families; biological mouse identity unavailable. Coverage accompanies every conditional error estimate.

cards.title: Common-ellipse coverage
cards.explanation: Fraction of corrected attempts with a retained common-ellipse geometry. Geometry errors must remain paired with fit/return coverage. Corrected DEVELOPMENT acquisition families; biological mouse identity unavailable. Coverage accompanies every conditional error estimate.

cards.title: Pupil center error
cards.explanation: Mean Euclidean center displacement under the frozen common-ellipse view. Center accuracy matters for eye-position analyses. Corrected DEVELOPMENT acquisition families; biological mouse identity unavailable. Coverage accompanies every conditional error estimate.

cards.title: Normalized center error
cards.explanation: Mean center error normalized by GT equivalent diameter. Normalizes displacement for pupil scale. Corrected DEVELOPMENT acquisition families; biological mouse identity unavailable. Coverage accompanies every conditional error estimate.

cards.title: Pupil area error
cards.explanation: Mean absolute relative ellipse-area error. Area can expose shape/scale failures hidden by one diameter. Corrected DEVELOPMENT acquisition families; biological mouse identity unavailable. Coverage accompanies every conditional error estimate.

cards.title: Major-axis error
cards.explanation: Mean absolute relative major-axis error. Separates long-axis geometry from overall diameter. Corrected DEVELOPMENT acquisition families; biological mouse identity unavailable. Coverage accompanies every conditional error estimate.

cards.title: Minor-axis error
cards.explanation: Mean absolute relative minor-axis error. Separates short-axis geometry from overall diameter. Corrected DEVELOPMENT acquisition families; biological mouse identity unavailable. Coverage accompanies every conditional error estimate.

cards.title: Ellipse eccentricity error
cards.explanation: Mean absolute error in ellipse eccentricity. Captures shape distortion independent of scale. Corrected DEVELOPMENT acquisition families; biological mouse identity unavailable. Coverage accompanies every conditional error estimate.
